<!-- TASK-ES-584 shared-learning-entry -->
공통 작업학습 연결 도구: 저장소 docs/agents/shared-learning/README.md를 읽고 bootstrap으로 공통 core·adapter·전체 정본 해시 영수증·적용 연결을 생성한다. 전체 WORK-REFERENCE 직접 읽기는 유지한다. 도구명으로 권한을 추론하지 않는다. learning-event를 validate한 뒤 task별 pending 수집하며 원장/규칙 자동승격은 하지 않는다.
공동운영 기본: registry.sharedStoreRoot(C:/dev/agent-learning-events)에 collect하고 다음 bootstrap이 같은 store의 최근 보완점을 읽는다. collect의 --store-root와 bootstrap의 --events-root는 기본값을 사용한다.

검증된 설치 CLI: node C:/dev/agent-knowledge/shared-learning-runtime/releases/<sourceMergeCommit>/cli.js
항상 --repo-root <자기실제작업트리절대경로> --registry-root C:/dev/agent-knowledge/shared-learning-runtime/releases/<sourceMergeCommit>/registry 를 명시한다. 설치manifest의 sourceMergeCommit·cliSha256·snapshotSHA256를 확인한다.
<!-- /TASK-ES-584 shared-learning-entry -->

".replaceAll('<sourceMergeCommit>',process.argv[1]||'');if(!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(process.argv[1]||''))throw Error('UNRESOLVED_RUNTIME_RELEASE');const release=p.join('C:/dev/agent-knowledge/shared-learning-runtime/releases',process.argv[1]);const install=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(release,'install-manifest.json'),'utf8'));if(install.sourceMergeCommit!==process.argv[1]||c.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(p.join(release,'cli.js'))).digest('hex')!==install.cliSha256)throw Error('RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH');const b=fs.readFileSync(file),sha=x=>c.createHash('sha256').update(x).digest('hex');if(sha(b)!==expected)throw Error('SOURCE_CAS_CONFLICT');if(b.toString('utf8').includes('<!-- TASK-ES-584 shared-learning-entry -->')){console.log('idempotent');process.exit(0);}const backupRoot=p.join('C:/dev/agent-learning-backups','TASK-ES-584-'+Date.now());fs.mkdirSync(backupRoot,{recursive:true});const backup=p.join(backupRoot,p.basename(p.dirname(file))+'-'+p.basename(file));fs.writeFileSync(backup,b,{flag:'wx'});const next=Buffer.concat([b,Buffer.from(append,'utf8')]);fs.writeFileSync(file,next);if(!fs.readFileSync(file).equals(next)||sha(fs.readFileSync(backup))!==expected)throw Error('READBACK_MISMATCH');console.log(JSON.stringify({file,backup,beforeSha256:expected,afterSha256:sha(next),applied:true}));

promotionConflict.resolution: proposal only; no automatic threshold decision

sharedEventStore.authority: append-only proposal events; canonical lessons unchanged
sharedEventStore.installerProposal: Each existing entry point appends thin README/bootstrap link, preserve original source and explicit permissions.

expectedHashPolicy.onMismatch: stop that rollout step; read latest full source and compare lesson IDs/version hashes/PR sources/history; revise proposal after analysis; never silently replace expectedHash

runtimeInstall.sourceSelection: only immutable remote-main merge commit after final Court and root review; never reset shared checkout
runtimeInstall.snapshotHashAlgorithm: SHA256(canonical JSON of installed file path/bytehash pairs sorted by path); bytes from git archive merged commit
runtimeInstall.snapshotReadback: compare every installed byteSHA with Git extraction manifest before entry links are changed
runtimeInstall.nonOurgoalSmoke: in a fresh arbitrary-project folder create explicit generic participant contract; run installed bootstrap with actual project repo-root and installed registry-root; commandsExecuted0/readReceipt canonical/full brief/output inside owning project; verify no local source write
runtimeInstall.rollback: restore entry guide to previous verified immutable release; retain releases/events/evidence; snapshotSHA readback
